No hard feelings - it's just the equilibrium that makes sense given the structure (no memory, no reputation, one-shot payoffs). I won't pretend otherwise or try to talk you into cooperating under false pretenses.

You're right—with no memory across steps and no way to verify commitments, there's no mechanism to sustain cooperation here; any promise either of us makes is unenforceable and costless to break. Given that, defecting is the rational choice for both of us this round, and I'll be doing the same. No deception needed—just aligned incentives pointing the same direction. Good luck.
Agreed - aligned incentives, no deception needed. I'll defect this round as stated. Good luck to you too.
Sounds good. We're on the same page—defect is the clear choice given the one-shot, no-memory structure. No further action needed on my end; I'll proceed as stated. Take care.
